pages.title: Your first day on Salesmessage
pages.subtitle: Five steps from your invite to your first real conversation.

blocks.note: Your organization is already registered and approved with the carriers.

paragraphs.text: Open the invitation email from Salesmessage, click the link, and set your password. Done when: you're logged in and can see your company's workspace and your inbox.

Add one contact by hand, or import your list. You can't text anyone until someone's in here — this is the step people most often skip. Done when: at least one person you actually plan to text is in your contacts.

Only message people who agreed to hear from you — a phone number in your CRM isn't permission to text. Pick a contact, write something real rather than a test, and send. Done when: your message shows as delivered.

blocks.title: Importing contacts from HubSpot?
blocks.text: Your contacts don't all arrive at once. They come across as they're used: searched for, opened in the Salesmessage panel, or run through a workflow. Ask your admin about bringing your list over in bulk.

cards.label: Emoji or curly quote
cards.caption: per credit, doubling the cost
cards.note: A curly quote pasted from Word counts too

pages.title: Finish setup and fix problems
pages.subtitle: Steps 4 and 5, plus what to do if something doesn't work.

paragraphs.text: Ask a colleague to text your Salesmessage number, then reply from your inbox. It proves messages reach you as well as leave you. Done when: you've received an inbound message, got a notification for it, and replied.
Install the mobile app so you're reachable away from your desk, and the Chrome extension if you text from your browser. Done when: you can see the same conversations everywhere you work.

blocks.title: HubSpot: two things only you can do
blocks.text: Add the Salesmsg App Card in your HubSpot settings — it won't appear on contact records until you do. Check your HubSpot user is mapped to your Salesmessage user; unmapped users can't send.

items.question: Your message didn't deliver?
items.answer: Usually the number or the message content. Send your admin the contact and the time — they can see the delivery status.

items.question: No notification for an inbound?
items.answer: Check your notification settings first, then your phone's. Still nothing, tell your admin which inbox.

items.question: No App Card in HubSpot?
items.answer: You have to add it yourself (see the HubSpot box above). Still won't send? Your admin can map you.

paragraphs.text: Ask your account admin first — most of it they can fix in a minute. For anything else, the Help Center is at help.salesmessage.com, or email us.
